dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's hear "The Battle of the Onmyouji."

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The mischievous tanuki are part of this story as well.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The nosy tanuki are always out and about with their pranks. But one day, they finally messed with someone they shouldn't have.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The Shogunate began to look into the matter and found that the mischief of a bake-danuki was to blame. They then sent an onmyouji by the name of Kamuna Harunosuke to deal with the problem.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: The poor little tanuki were no match for the great Onmyouji... In the end, all the tanuki were sealed inside Chinju Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: So if you ever hear strange voices in the forest, it might be the tanuki saying "Help me~ Heeeelp me~~"...
